nom: Jack Black All-Over Wash for Face, Hair & Body

avis.texte: We love the Jack Black line for beard care. We were sad that Ulta stopped carrrying the Beard Wash so i had compared ingredients with that and this product and it looked almost identical. This product makes my husband's beard so soft and using the beard oil after really is a great combo for softening and maintaining the feel and look. The best part is you get soo much more in this bottle for a better price.
Really enjoying the fresh, long lasting deep clean from this cleanser. Although I also bought the lotion a week later the cleanser leaves my skin soft, not dried out.
My husband loves this wash. I also use it in the shower as a facial cleanser.

I love the scent and very much love the size of the container. It lasts for a long while. I'm always getting compliments on how fresh I smell. It feels great on my skin. Without doubt, I will use that as long as it is available to me. Thanks for creating great products

I've recently purchased this body wash and I love the smell and the cleaning capabilities. I'm nervous about the pump when i get towards the bottom of the bottle, but the product itself is great! Would definitely recommend to others and will continue to purchase in the future.
Long time fan of JB, product quality is spot on and fragrances very masculine

avis.titre: Do not Stop making All Over Body Wash
avis.texte: i have tried your other washes and nothing beats the fresh smell of the All over wash. everybody comments on how fresh it smells! Keep this in your product line!

Feels good, smells great, but the bottle pump is awful! Is there any you can send me a new pump? I must say that I have the Turbo and the Reserve body wash in 33 oz. bottles as well and they work fine.

Aftera long workout you just wanna wash your whole head and there is no other wash on the market I've found to was your face and hair so well. The lather is perfect. The only thing is there's only 1 scent [citrus- mint- oakmoss] Would be amazing to have in their signature scents or even a new specific to all-over-wash
Great wash. Cleans hair. and body well. Moisturizing without any film. Nice scent. All a man needs.
Tried all of the body wash scents over the years but always go back to the "All Over Wash". It's a classic that I never grow tired of.
It works well for shower gel and smells good. It didn't seem to work as well for hair. I'd rather see a shampoo/conditioner product sold separately.

I've used this body wash before and thoroughly enjoyed the smell and lather it provided. I have tried a few big name brands and they fell short in terms of scent, lather and the amount of product that comes with the cost.

Just make it a regular pour lid. How can you ignore so many complaints about the pump you use for your product? Just change them to a lid that is a pour style. Why haven't you fixed the issue? Pretty stupid. It ruins an otherwise great product.

I love the concept of the face-hair-body 'all in one' wash; and, it works as advertised…very convenient to use. But, my skin prefers something with aloe…this product does not contain aloe. My bad. After sampling a couple other hair-body products (Big Sur and Midnight Summer) which do contain aloe, I ordered the Midnight Summer and am very pleased.

avis.titre: I have bought this product again and again for my husband
avis.texte: The All-Over wash from jack Black is fantastic. It declutters the shower since only one product is needed for my husband and secretly I use it too at times. I love the scent and it really leaves both hair and skin clean and subtle.

avis.titre: still waiting for a refill option
avis.texte: I like this product, but I don't need a new bottle or dispensing cap. All I need it the product itself delivered in disposable packaging. JB has told me months ago they were working on this but so far, NOTHING. Will there ever be a refill option??
This is the GOAT. I recently ordered Blue Midnight and it's ok. All-over is the best body wash out there. Please please please fix the pump tho!
I thought I was buying Turbo Wash and bought this by mistake. Scent is too strong for my taste but the Turbo Wash is great!
Had been using the turbo wash but the smell of this is amazing!
Great product recent changes to the pump is not making the product not dispense properly.

Had to write here about this amazing and versatile product. It was the scent at first that drew me to this product but after using it as my go to face cleanser I wont use anything else. Great work Jack! Keep it up!
LOVE IT! Great scent, lathers well and skin feels super clean.
Great thick consistency, Refreshing Scent, without the unpleasant (when not desired), "menthol chill" , Hydrating & excellent for most sensitive skin types.

avis.titre: Love it, but try to Private Reserve too
avis.texte: I recently switched to Jack Black products and I seriously have never felt more fresh after a shower. This one sorta smells like a strong aftershave, but I bought the Private Reserve in the black bottle and it smells amazing!

The dispenser wouldn't open. I tried everything to spin it around but that basically rendered it useless. I had another bottle of similar jack black but you changed the bottle and the new dispenser was too big for the old bottle. Also, the smell is a little strong but that's just a personal preference. Would have rated it a 4 otherwise. I love the pure clean face wash and the all over wash.
Great product and long time user. Never gets old, always feel refreshed after using.
This is my hubby's favorite face wash. He loves it because he really feels like it cleans his face and beard and he has been pretty picky about his face washes.
I've been buying this wash for years now, it's a fresh but musky smell. It is thick and lathers really well. One pump and your good.

I really like the size of the bottle for the shower and how well it works with soft water. It definitely gives your body a soft feel after showering. I like using it on wash cloth for quick clean ups as well.

avis.titre: All in One for every man!
avis.texte: We received some samples and that was it for my husband. This all in one is perfect and easy for any man to use. The scent is fresh and no reactions for sensitive skin. Wash your hair, your body with this huge bottle. A most have in our house!

avis.titre: My boyfriend's go - to product!  He loves it!
avis.texte: I introduced my redneck boyfriend to this line and this product he can not live without! From head to toe, this product is great!

avis.titre: Scent is not too great for showers
avis.texte: I'm not a fan of the perfume scent in the body wash, but I do like it better for the lotion version. The eucalyptus wash is much more appealing.
Best I've used so far. One bottle lasts me 8 months so, worth the price.
Good fragrance that lingers well. Have definitely felt a difference in the way it makes my skin feel and for the better.
this was my favorite by far of any line or brand until JB released Big Sir body wash. equally good but i prefer the Big Sir scent.

Very, very effective for the body. Smells great and really cleans well without drying out the skin. Not that great for longer hair though, but you really shouldn't be using a 3-in-1 if you have longer hair.
The quality of the Turbo Wash, from texture, to lather, to smell is CHAMPIONSHIP! The customer service is tier 1! You certainly get your bang for your buck!
Need to travel at warp speed and still smell fresh as fruit? Talk to Jack.
I really like the refreshed feeling I have after a shower. My wife also likes the smell. I would definitely recommend it.
I love the way it leaves my skin and hair clean and soft and I totally love the scent. The pump keeps things easy. And again-I love the scent! It's a wonderful product!
Hands down the best body wash I've ever used. Great for the gym, travel or guys who don't want the trouble of using multiple products.
Great product! Use it for my body, and thickening shampoo for my hair! Amazing 1,2 punch for my shower routine!
This soap sticks to the skin in... globs? It doesn't clean thoroughly. It is hard to rinse off.
I enjoy this product. It feels great on my skin and smells even better!
My 5 star rating reflects how much I like your product. The price is a bit steep but well worth it…Thanks!!
Awesome body wash! The smell is fantastic when using this you realize why you pay a lil more. Will never go back!!!!
Great body wash that cleans well, rinses well, and does not dry out skin or hair. The fragrance reminds me of a body shop...kinda smells like air freshener and grease but its not horrible.

avis.titre: Been using this for about 8 years now
avis.texte: This has been my daily body/face/hair wash for about 8 years now. Every now and then I try a different body wash but keeping coming back to this one. It's the perfect balance of cleaning power and moisturizing power. I find most body washes either too weak to clean properly or too strong which dries out my skin. Also, the scent is the best; no other body wash in my opinion smells as good as this one. I also followup my shower with the matching body spray. I really love the scent they use.
A great product. Versatile. Love that. Your skin remains moist. No over drying.

avis.titre: Jack Black All Over Is A Great Body Wash
avis.texte: I am completely satisfied with Jack Black All Over Body Wash. It cleans well and has a pleasant odor.
I started with a sample and loved it so I had to purchase more. I really like the results especially with being able to use it on my hair. Very convenient.
Great lather and cleaning power. Will leave skin smooth and hydrated. I will purchase again. This product is well worth the price. A little goes a long way. Thank you! MWS FLINT, MI
Love this product!!Smells great. Thanks for making a great product
Gives me a fresh clean feeling after using it when I shower. I recommend it.

Smell is always a matter of personal preference, but the fragrance of this wash was so overpowering it nearly choked me. I would actually prefer no fragrance and more focus on a formula with skin benefits. This wash did not improve my skin in any way - no noticeable moisture, softness, redness reduction / calming effect, clearer skin etc. The consistency was thick, creamy, and sticky. I prefer a thinner, more fluid consistency with a rich lather.

avis.titre: I keep this in my shower and travel bag.
avis.texte: I use it regularly and on travel. Even my brother has begun using it.

I REALLY like this wash. Doesn't dry out my skin or leave an oily residue after use. The wash has a silky texture that lathers easily. Leaves my skin feeling clean and refreshed. Has a clean, fresh fragrance to it. It has quickly grown on me. I would definitely recommend giving it a try.

This Jack Black body wash has a mild scent. It makes you feel nice and clean. If you like to use cologne quite frequently. The scent of the body wash won't overpower the scent of the cologne. Most Old Spice body washes do that. Buf this body wash won't. It's very good to use before a date if you want to have a fresh scent. Then put on your favorite cologne. So, if you haven't used this body wah yet. Give it a try. All Jack Black products do a great job. If you haven't used any. Look at your local store. They're worth your money.
I would recommend Jack Black all over to everyone. It leaves my skin smooth and soft. I'm 68 and I need it for my skin.

I am allergic to most soaps and body washes. This one does cost more than most, but it's totally worth it. I've been using it for well over three years. On a side note, my girlfriend would not allow me to use anything else even if I wanted to. She comments about how much she loves the scent. It is not overpowering and leaves my skin super soft.
I've always been a big fan of the All-Over Wash, it leaves you clean and smells incredible. I get tons of compliments. Goes great with Pit Boss

avis.titre: My man LOVES and so do I!!!
avis.texte: Very hydrating and amazing scent!! Will be buying again for sure!!

I bought this body wash because it was vegan and also it had good reviews. I mean yea smells good but nothing special about it as I expected it as it said in reviews. Its pricy for a normal body wash. Wont buy it again

avis.titre: Excellent Body Wash - Leaves My Skin Feeling Great
avis.texte: I love this body wash. Before I found Jack Black, I was going through so many brand name products from local retailers trying to find something that didn't leave my skin red and dry. None of them were good. This product is excellent. I feel like my skin is soft and smooth. The smell is great and I feel it makes the right amount of lather. I compared this to Turbo Wash and I much prefer this product. I feel it lathers better and leaves my skin feeling healthier.

Bought this body wash because of its wonderful smell. It smells like a fresh mojito tastes': citrus mint mixed with clear rum. The smell in the lather is much stronger than what's left on your skin afterward, which is a good thing. The strong hit of eucalyptus wakes you up, and the soothing aroma of rosemary, citrus, and musk relax your aches and pains away. Love it. Wish the price were a bit more reasonable, but, what can you do.
Absolutely love this body wash. The scent is fantastic, so much so that I purchased the body spray.

I had really high hopes for this product, and I am sad to say the All-Over Wash did not live up to those. This is nothing more than an overpriced wash that you would find on a big-box store shelf for a fraction of the cost. The product is also sometimes hard to wash off your body, which I found very odd given its consistency. I did not feel refreshed after a shower. This is not what I expected from Jack Black.
A great product- can't imagine my morning routine without it. Smells like heaven!
Great product and very versatile. I love having the 3 oz bottle for travel too. Thx
I like this body wash a lot. The scent it's one of my favorites.
My husband uses this daily. He has dry and sensitive skin and this does not leave him dry and itchy. It has an invigorating minty scent. It lathers a lot which he likes, and rinses off easily.

JB hit a homerun with this Product. The All-Over Wash is AWESOME. Love the smell and the clean/refreshing feeling you get from using it. I only use it for my body, but have used it when traveling for hair as well, and it works great as a shampoo too.
Awesome product. Smells clean and not over powering. Leaves you feeling refreshed after showering. I highly recommend this product.
Love this stuff with a loofa.. or exfoliating gloves... goes on easy washes off clean... my wife love the way the shower smells after I'm done... compliments any cologne you wear that day as well.
This All Over Wash cannot be beat. Cleans nicely, especially with sensitive skin. The scent is very pleasant. Well worth the money.
Smells great . Smooth felling after shower, gets the job done. Highly recommend
Very good for at night before bed. Will not wake you up like the energizer wash in the mornings, yet smells so Jack Black!

avis.titre: Super clean feeling after using this product.
avis.texte: Highly recommend! Smells great and is a great alternative to Turbo Wash.

This is a versatile product; great for travel, home or the gym. I've even used it as a shave lather in a pinch. It won't dry out your skin and has a sophisticated fragrance that isn't overpowering. A staple of my Jack Black line up.
I switched to Jack Black to try a new body wash, i really like the scent, very fresh and masculine. The liquid is very rich and worked great as shampoo. I will certainly recommend and repurchase
Bought for boyfriend and he likes product, smells great and he uses it for all body( including beard)
Good lather, but the scent that so many rave about, was hugely disappointing. Smells faintly of eucalyptus. Not refreshing. Not masculine. I won't purchase again.

avis.titre: I have bought this a few times & will probably buy again
avis.texte: Lathers & smells good. Use as body , face & sometimes hair wash.
My favorite bodywash. The scent of it is unmatched. You can definitely tell its a luxury product. Worth every penny, and with the big size it lasts months.
This product is crucial when it comes to leaving my skin dry... I mean it smells decent but my skin feels bad afterwards.

Does a great job leaving me clean all over. Also has a nice smell to it. Love that I no longer have that dry skin itchy feeling after I'm done showering. Have purchased multiple times and would recommend.
Nice, smooth and different. Refreshing scent. It would be better if the scent stayed on your body, but the all over body spray helps with that.
All my husband will use. He showers at least once per day and he maybe goes through 2 of the large size per year. Smells awesome, and a great all in one for a guy who actually cares about his hair.

avis.titre: I use it more than he does
avis.texte: Love this and the eucalyptus smell really wakes me up in the early morning hours. My and my guy share this when I originally bought it for him but I use it everyday!
Jack black products are the best. When I am in a hurry or traveling there's nothing better. Great scent and easy to use
I have been using this for years now and would never go back to anything else. Skin feels great and so do I after using it

My husband and I recently discovered the Jack Black products and this was our first purchase. It's a terrific way to soap up in the shower. We've both found that our skin and hair feel much cleaner besides smelling GREAT!

This stuff works great, but when I got the package the pump had apparently released and coated everything inside with all over wash. It was probably an ounce or so, but was tough to tell. I usually don't nitpik about these things, but thought it would be helpful to you.

avis.titre: All Over Wash is in second place, Turbo Wash has it beat.
avis.texte: I like the all over wash but am partial towards the turbo wash that I prefer more. It is very nice but the turbo wash gives me a real refreshing clean and fragrance.
Since my husband stating using Jack Black he doesn't want to use anything else!
I bought it for my boyfriend it lasted 3 months almost and he loved it so much I bought it again!

avis.titre: I would definitely buy this again. My husband loves it!!
avis.texte: My husband uses this as his daily body wash and shampoo and absolutely loves it!
I've purchased this many times for my husband and he loves it! Great product!!

avis.titre: I bought this one time and haven't gone back since
avis.texte: My wife bought me this quite some time back and I have yet to use anything else. I am definitely addicted now

avis.titre: Refreshing bath wash that adds moisture and clean feeling.
avis.texte: Always dependable to clean and control hair. Great smell. Used for many years and will continue!

Bought this for my minimalist husband about 3 years ago, and from the start he was hooked! He loves the simplicity of needing just one product in the shower to do it all. He smells amazingly and looks great day in and day out. In fact, we even use it to wash my Vizsla dog and everyone comments how great he always smells.

I bought this for my husband as a small Valentine's Day gift. That started it... now it is the only product he uses. He washes his body beard and hair all at once. It smells invigorating in the shower and makes the bathroom have a clean smell after which I like. He has been using it for 3 years now and still loves it.
This is my son and husbands favorite product. They even love the travel size for trips.
Bought this for my husband and he loves it! It smells great and doesn't dry out your skin or hair. The bottle was also a nice size that lasted him a while. Definitely buying again!
This is something that has to be in my bathroom at all times. Everyone must give it a try
Got it for my bf who's a minimalist when it comes to products. He enjoyed the smell and loved its multiple purposes.
